Eligible 3762 post registration active subset; no complete all-registered roster
Delayed leaderboard 3+ days; offer Z vs actual exposure E vs within-treatment rank/distance R not conflated
Dispersion beta 0.092 in Table 4 is postallocation association, not randomized causal rank manipulation
Published user-clustered SE, 108171 user-day rows not 108171 human subjects
No independent replication, data license or effect novel to PFL
